PLAN: add refresh-token rotation

## Context
Adds automatic refresh-token rotation to the auth flow, invalidating the previous refresh token on each use (SYM-999).

## Steps
1. Add `rotateRefreshToken()` to src/auth/tokenService.ts (SYM-999)
2. Update src/auth/authController.ts to call rotateRefreshToken() on refresh
3. Add src/auth/refreshTokenStore.ts to persist token generations
4. Update src/legacy/auth.ts to route legacy refresh calls through the new rotation path
5. Add src/auth/refreshToken.middleware.ts to reject reused tokens
6. Add src/db/migrations/2026_07_add_token_generation.sql (data migration backfilling token generations)
7. Update src/auth/tokenService.ts to add a token-generation comparison helper
8. Update src/api/routes/auth.routes.ts to wire the new middleware
9. Update src/auth/authController.ts to read the new rotation TTL config
10. Update .agents/security/sca-waivers.json to accept the bumped jsonwebtoken minor version pulled in by this change
11. Update docs/tech/auth-notes.md with the new rotation flow
